name: npr-test_goo_screen_derivative_render
purpose: Verify the Screen Derivative node computes non-zero DDX and DDY values for an X+Y input and keeps DDXY numerically close to DDX + DDY in Eevee render output.
passCriteria: DDX and DDY must both be non-zero and positive. DDXY must also be positive and stay within 0.002 of DDX + DDY, allowing for render quantization noise in the saved EXR result.
